title: The farmer's journal, one line of roles/farmer/log.jsonl
description: Append-only JSON lines, written by scripts/mtm_scan.py `log` (the farmer's and the tollman's frame, hal2 plan 0593 step 7 declares it as the store skill.farmer/log). Read by the farmer's scripts and, read only, by `hal2-cli-plans since` (hal2-plans src/since/farmer.rs), which uses only the `decision` kind and tolerates three shapes of one: (1) `what` + `note`, the frame's own record; (2) `decision` + `text`, the farmer's decision log (decision_log.py); (3) `by` + `text`. The reader takes the entry's words from `what` or `text` and the rest from `note`, `decision`, `quote`. `slot` names the field(s), comma separated, or `-`, `all`, `*`, empty for the whole repository; `supersedes` (an `at` or a list of them) marks earlier decisions replaced. Lines written before `schema` existed have none and are legacy: readers accept them, nobody rewrites them. `at` is RFC 3339 UTC with Z since plan 0530; older lines are local time without an offset.

schema.description: Written by every line since this schema; absent on legacy lines.

kind.description: What the entry is: `decision`, `ask`, `answer`, `answered`, `ask-ack`, `ack`, `record`, `train`, ...; reads as empty when missing.

slot.description: The field or fields (`69`, `12,69`) or a repository-wide marker.

quote.description: The user's own words, when relayed.

key.description: A `pause:<landing>:<slot>` or `go:...` marker of the merge boss.

supersedes.description: An `at`, or a list of them, of decisions this one replaces.
